g.text: Shared, persistent memory that lets AI assistants hand work over to each other.
show the latest handoff of a project
handoff history as a graph, newest first
compare two handoffs word by word (default: the last two)
activity, agents and branches of a project
previous handoffs in full, newest first
save a handoff (for assistants without MCP); '-' reads stdin
make an older handoff the latest again
delete a project's memory and history
write a project's memory (or all of it) to JSON Lines, for backups or another machine
add the handoffs of an export to this machine's memory (never twice)
show where Handoff stores its data
connect Handoff to the AI tools installed on this machine (asks before changing anything)
check how Handoff is connected to each AI tool
Tab completion for your shell (zsh, bash, PowerShell)
handoff <command> --help shows the options. Tab completes commands once completion is installed.
